records.proposal: You chose The agent keeps getting everything as text (brief, stale links, untraced files, warnings); the owner sees cards only; the full/compact/off setting is retired over The agent is told only what blocks it, Keep the old text for both, with the full/compact/off setting
You chose Say so once and block the step that needs the judge; work that needs no judge goes on; nothing is decided by rule over Say so once and skip, never block, Fall back to simple rules

You chose Never by default: plumb checks the requirement is still covered and repins; a card only when the requirement should change fundamentally or two confirmed records contradict over A card on every change to what the owner confirmed, A card only on contradictions, everything else settled by the agent

Cards are few and high-level: plumb asks you the principle a group of detailed questions hinges on, you decide it once, and plumb settles the detailed cards from that decision. Three principles are decided now: the agent keeps getting everything as text and you see cards only; when no judge can be reached plumb says so and blocks the step that needs it; a change to code or tests linked to a requirement is first checked for still covering it, and a card comes only when the requirement should change fundamentally or two confirmed records contradict

When several open cards, or the gaps and conflicts of a request, hinge on one principle, plumb asks it once (one card naming what it would settle, or the request check's question for a commanded clarify) rather than each detail; once the owner's decision on it is confirmed, a background job settles each dependent card from the decision's words: withdrawn when answered, its link repinned when the meaning is kept, or a rewording proposed as an unconfirmed edit, each citing the decision, told in the one plumb line and undoable; a card the model cannot settle from the decision stays

The agent keeps receiving the session brief, the stale links, the untraced files and the warnings as text in its channel, with the panel up or not; the owner sees cards and the one plumb line only; the full/compact/off intent-card setting is retired

When no judge can be reached (no key, timeout, API down), plumb says so once and the step that needed it (auto-approval, settling, triage, calibration, the stale check) waits until a judge is back; nothing is decided by rule; work that needs no judge goes on, and the request check keeps its build-anyway-or-wait card

When code or tests linked to a requirement change and the requirement did not, plumb first checks the requirement is still covered: its linked tests pass and a model judges the meaning kept; then it repins and logs, with no card; a card is raised only when the requirement should change fundamentally (a confirmed example’s test weakened or deleted with no replacement, or the model says the statement or an example would now say something else) or when two confirmed records contradict
